pieces.title: An impulse, then the impulse looped
pieces.caption: One click, then silence: a baton, carried once and gone. At five seconds the same click is dropped into a loop. Each pass catches what the last one left, rounds it a little, and drops it back: a steward. *What is real and what is a choice:* The page's two sentences, 'A baton is an impulse' and 'A steward is that impulse looped', taken literally.
